summary: This note is a short biographical sketch of Olivera Katarina, covering her childhood training and early education. It notes her piano and ballet lessons as a child, a 1959 stay in Paris to study French at the Alliance Française, and her university path from law to dramatic arts. It also names two fellow students at the Faculty of Dramatic Arts.
one_line: Biographical note on actress Olivera Katarina's childhood training, 1959 Paris French studies, and university education in Belgrade.
key_facts: As a child, Olivera Katarina attended piano and ballet lessons.
In 1959, Olivera Katarina went to Paris.
In Paris, Olivera Katarina enrolled at the Alliance Française school to improve her French language skills.
Olivera Katarina initially enrolled at the University of Belgrade Faculty of Law.
Olivera Katarina later switched to the Faculty of Dramatic Arts.
Milena Dravić was among Olivera Katarina's mates at the Faculty of Dramatic Arts.
Petar Kralj was among Olivera Katarina's mates at the Faculty of Dramatic Arts.
